description: This file defines a React functional component 'LiteLLMModelNameField' which provides a user interface for selecting and managing model names within a form, tailored for different AI providers such as Azure, OpenAI, and Ollama. It includes logic for handling model selection, custom model name input, and special cases like wildcards and deployment names.

methods.name: handleModelChange
methods.description: Handles change events for model selection, updates form fields based on selected models, including handling special cases like 'all-wildcard'.

methods.name: handleAzureDeploymentNameChange
methods.description: Updates model mappings when an Azure deployment name is entered.

methods.name: handleCustomModelNameChange
methods.description: Updates model mappings dynamically when a custom model name is entered.
